bio: The colour scheme speaks of immaculate purity. The white interior is refreshing; the blank spaces left in the arrangements bring clarity of focus. Eager to share the attractions of his hometown with the world, the chef largely gets his ingredients from Hamada, Shimane Prefecture. Seafood arrives from former classmates; fruit from farmers for his desserts. The style is Italian-based cuisine made with Japanese foodstuffs, bringing the delicious taste of quality ingredients to the fore....
